scripts.build: export envt=prod ; npm run _buildenv && npm run verify
scripts.buildbeta: eval "$(node scripts/build_num.js --get)" ; export envt=beta ; npm run _buildenv && npm run verify && npm run deploy
scripts.buildalpha: eval "$(node scripts/build_num.js --bump)" ; export envt=alpha ; npm run _buildenv && npm run deploy
scripts._buildenv: npm run clean ; npm run transpile ; npm run minify ; npm run minifyscore ; npm run minifytv ; npm run assemble ; npm run dist
scripts.clean: npm run _tempclean ; npm run _distclean ; npm run _repoclean
scripts.assemble: npm run _copy ; npm run _tvcopy ; npm run _scorecopy ; npm run _webcopy
scripts._copy: mkdir -p ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/lib ; mkdir -p ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/img ; mkdir -p ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/common ; mkdir -p ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/workers ; cp src/lib/*.js ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/lib ; cp src/img/* ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/img ; cp ../larn-deploy/_tmp/common/patch.js ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/common ; cp src/larn.html ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn ; cp src/larn.css ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn ; cp ../larn-deploy/_tmp/larn.min.js ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn ; cp ../larn-deploy/_tmp/workers/*.js ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/workers || true
scripts._tvcopy: mkdir -p ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/tv ; cp ../larn-deploy/_tmp/tv/larntv.min.js ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/tv ; cp src/tv/index.html ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/tv ; cp src/tv/larntv.css ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/tv || true
scripts._scorecopy: mkdir -p ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/score ; cp ../larn-deploy/_tmp/score/score.min.js ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/score ; cp src/score/index.html ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/score ; cp src/score/score.css ../larn-deploy/_dist/$envt/larn/score || true
scripts.deploy: echo "BUILD=$BUILD" ; git -C ../larn-deploy/$envt add -A ; git -C ../larn-deploy/$envt commit -m "$BUILD" ; git -C ../larn-deploy/$envt push
